label: Ṣarf — how this piece forms the word
text: Ṣarf — how this piece forms the word: The root س ف ه is retained. The singular سَفِيه follows فَعِيل; the plural body سُفَهَاء follows فُعَلَاء. The paired certified augment inventories name ي for the singular and ا + ء for the plural, so the plural has no ي.
